C-RU-CORPUS-PORTAL.Summary: Continue the owner-authorized Russian translation across Registry, Portfolio and all authored portal content, using the completed charter as the governing terminology and meaning baseline.

Goals.Goal: Complete matching Russian translations of all 41 Registry records, 15 Portfolio files, 117 portal Markdown pages and remaining authored JSON strings.
Reconcile terminology against all 39 reviewed charter files and render the Russian site from the selected Russian sources.

Constraints.Constraint: Authority: the owner explicitly requested continuing registry, charter and portal/content including authored.json, then added portfolio. Reuse the established sequential translation, semantic review and verification process.
Preserve identifiers, dates, quantities, evidence, operational statuses, uncertainty, external-source links and decision rights. Neither language is authoritative by default.
Protect unrelated work and the approved English comparison sources; translate existing statements without inventing legal or operational updates.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Change policies or recorded decisions, claim human approval of translations, publish additional operational records, commit, push or deploy.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All requested content has complete Russian counterparts with accurate source metadata and equivalent meaning, including shared authored strings.
Existing charter translations remain valid; generated Russian pages, titles, diagrams, search and navigation follow translated content, with any Portfolio-derived facts preserved.
Source checks, established tests, scaffolding checks, deterministic rebuild and representative browser inspection pass.
